mentions.claim_text: He says the word was battalions concerning Syria, and works out with his co-host that a battalion is three hundred to a thousand soldiers.
mentions.quote: I saw battalions. Battalions concerning Syria
mentions.falsify_match: Battalion sized formations deploy in or out of Syria.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord had much more for the president to do, that his legacy would be about a ballroom, and describes him standing on its steps looking out at his accomplishment with the missed ear behind him.
mentions.quote: I saw that his legacy would be about a ballroom
mentions.falsify_match: The ballroom becomes the defining item of the term.
mentions.falsify_miss: The term is remembered for something else.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a void ahead concerning the Save America Act, that the Lord told him to speak to the void, and that it needs support structure like steel beams.
mentions.quote: I saw a void concerning the Save America Act
mentions.falsify_match: The act passes after parts are split off and supported.
mentions.falsify_miss: The act fails entirely, or passes intact without splitting.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the president standing in a kind of shadow with the vice president on his right hand in a red tie, white shirt and blue jacket, both looking out at the lawn.
mentions.quote: JD Vance was on his right hand
mentions.falsify_match: The vice president stands as successor at a moment matching the scene.

mentions.claim_text: He says the president's approval rating will go down to twenty five per cent and he will have a stalemate presidency, and that while people expect an assassination the real danger is to his children, like a Kennedy curse.
mentions.quote: his approval rating will go down to 25%
mentions.falsify_match: Approval polling falls to around twenty five per cent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Approval stays above forty. Presidential approval has not gone below twenty five since Truman.

mentions.claim_text: He says those who cannot get to the president will take out his children, and that he saw a plan against the judges, the Supreme Court and certain senators, but refuses to call that the man's legacy.
mentions.quote: can't get to Trump will take out his kids
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against the president's children or against Supreme Court justices.

mentions.claim_text: He says the focus has drifted from making America great to foreign policy on Israel and Iran, and that people simply showing up to vote is what matters.
mentions.quote: We got to stick to that. Make America great again
mentions.falsify_match: Domestic policy displaces foreign policy as the administration's focus.

mentions.claim_text: He says winning depends on showing up at the polls in two years, and refers to the darkness he saw trying to come on the land through a coming term for the California governor.
mentions.quote: going into this next term of Gavin and the darkness
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom takes national office and conditions worsen.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to watch, and that he saw a massive hurricane coming toward Mar-a-Lago and West Palm Beach, tied to how America handles Israel and a two-state solution.
mentions.quote: I saw a major hurricane coming towards Mar-a-Lago
mentions.falsify_match: A major hurricane makes landfall at West Palm Beach.

mentions.claim_text: He calls in the number twenty million as a surplus, repeated several times, and thanks God for two million going to twenty million.
mentions.quote: I see the number 20 million. A surplus
mentions.falsify_match: The ministry reports income at that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He declares the church note paid off in full and God as the God of the abundant harvest, calling it the jet fuel for what they are about to see.
mentions.quote: I RECEIVE THE church note paid off in full
mentions.falsify_match: The mortgage is discharged.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a story of a racetrack owner giving a three million dollar cheque toward Oral Roberts University after hearing a broadcast, calling it a divine appointment.
mentions.quote: he gave him a check for three million bucks
mentions.falsify_match: The account is historically accurate.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not; the story is told from memory.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that God will shake the Mount of Olives, Israel and Jerusalem, that he sees the Dome of the Rock shaken, and that false temples including a Buddha temple will be shaken down to being uninhabitable.
mentions.quote: AND I SEE THE DOME OF THE ROCK SHAKEN
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake damages the Dome of the Rock and Asian temples.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against drones from Cuba or from any foreign or domestic source, calls for an uncovering, and prays over stadiums naming the New York Yankees, the Boston Red Sox and the World Cup.
mentions.quote: drones coming from Cuba or foreign or domestic
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on an American stadium or World Cup venue.

mentions.claim_text: Recalling a word given before New Year's Eve, he says he kept hearing men behind tables saying this is just business.
mentions.quote: I kept hearing them say behind tables, this is just business
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime becomes a visible factor in the New York conflict he describes.

mentions.claim_text: He describes bad men becoming heroes by resisting the Islamic push and Sharia law, seen in Chicago, Boston, New Orleans and heavily in New York, with Sicily heard repeatedly.
mentions.quote: bad guys that would become heroes
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime groups publicly oppose Islamic institutions in those cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said five families, five, running out of Chicago and Boston, and calls the New York mayoral figure evil.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, Five families, five
mentions.falsify_match: The five New York crime families act against the incoming administration.

mentions.claim_text: Replaying a recording from the 28th, he restates that he hears Sharia law rising up.
mentions.quote: This is on the 28th. Sharia law rising up
mentions.falsify_match: Sharia based provisions are adopted in America.

mentions.claim_text: He says the crime families do not want Sharia law or the new mayor because they like their organised crime and their way of doing things, and that a major turf war is coming in which they will look like the heroes.
mentions.quote: I see a turf war coming, a major turf war
mentions.falsify_match: An organised crime conflict over Islamic influence in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will look like the good guys but it is a turf war, because they do not want what they built in New York going to the Muslims with the temples and the changes the new mayor wants.
mentions.quote: they will look like the good guys, but it's a turf war
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime is publicly cast as defending the city.

mentions.claim_text: He quotes them refusing to allow an Islamic brotherhood to take over New York City, says he saw Little Italy, and that the Lord kept telling him to look at the vision of the five families.
mentions.quote: we're not going to allow the Muslims to come in and take over New York
mentions.falsify_match: Organised opposition of that kind emerges in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says the antichrist spirit will be called the Mahdi and that it is getting root in America now while most people have their heads in the sand.
mentions.quote: Antichrist spirit will be called the Mahdi
mentions.falsify_match: A figure identified as the Mahdi rises to global prominence.

mentions.claim_text: He says the target is to cause great rioting in New York in the days ahead, which will be blamed on the far right in red hats, but that it will not be them.
mentions.quote: they would blame it upon their far right with mega hats
mentions.falsify_match: Major rioting in New York is publicly attributed to the far right.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such rioting or no such attribution.

mentions.claim_text: Watching footage of burning, he says he sees in part and hears in part, and that he saw a civil war trying to break forth, asking for prayer for peace over the nation.
mentions.quote: I saw a civil war trying to break forth
mentions.falsify_match: Organised armed conflict between American factions.

mentions.claim_text: He replays a clip of a figure he calls the poster boy for the New York mayor, and jokes about a broadcaster's reaction to it the day before.
mentions.quote: this is the poster boy for Mandabi
mentions.falsify_match: The figure becomes representative of the administration.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a report that China plans to build a warning system to spot dangerous asteroids and wants to know when they are coming, and says they already knew about it.
mentions.quote: China plans to build a warning system to spot dangerous asteroids
mentions.falsify_match: China builds the system and an object is tracked toward Earth.
mentions.falsify_miss: The programme is routine planetary defence with no object inbound.

mentions.claim_text: He says China does not like Starlink flying overhead and wants to upset Elon Musk, then turns to Japan and Bitcoin backed digital credit products as the Sooners moving first.
mentions.quote: So China don't like it that Starlink's flying over their head
mentions.falsify_match: China acts against Starlink while Asian markets lead on crypto products.

mentions.claim_text: Correcting himself from Japan to Taiwan, he says Taiwan passed it first and is jumping on the boat, and that it is all going in line for the new digital age.
mentions.quote: So Taiwan's jumping on the boat first
mentions.falsify_match: Asian jurisdictions legislate on crypto before America.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. He names Japan, then corrects to Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will spread through Canada and Europe on the internet waves, that it will grab hold of live streams so people cannot say what they want under the First Amendment, and that he saw a spider building a web around it.
mentions.quote: I saw a spider build its web and start to wrap our first amendment
mentions.falsify_match: Live stream speech restrictions spread from Europe to North America.

mentions.claim_text: He confirms with his co-host that Europe voted to allow authorities to read private material on personal computers and that it cannot be stopped.
mentions.quote: they're able to all your private stuff on your computers
mentions.falsify_match: The measure is enacted and applied.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a different AI and great darkness concerning the internet, says people accuse him of speaking fear, and that he is warning them because they are in the last of the last days.
mentions.quote: It was great darkness concerning the internet
mentions.falsify_match: A major disruption or takeover of internet access.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will burn churches in Chicago, thousand year old churches in Europe and hundred year old churches in America, and repeats seeing holes in the Statue of Liberty burning from within.
mentions.quote: Thousand-year old churches are going to burn in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of church arson across those places.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson rates stay at their long term level.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw it happening in the middle of the night with chemical weapons, alongside a report of a thousand missiles locked and loaded aimed at Iran.
mentions.quote: I saw it happening in the middle of night, but it was with chemical weapons
mentions.falsify_match: A night time chemical attack.

mentions.claim_text: He says he would take extra security, that it is not the president they are after so much as his children, and that he saw it again that day while driving.
mentions.quote: it's not him that they're after as much as they are as children
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against the president's children.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are about to see one of the greatest moves of God any generation has seen, making Azusa Street look small, with Azusa Streets all over America.
mentions.quote: it makes Azusa Street look like something small
mentions.falsify_match: Multiple simultaneous revival centres across America.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the Save America Act as a big void with a membrane, and says there are bills outside that circle that would be just as significant if they can be got done.
mentions.quote: there's things outside of it that are bills that would be just as significant
mentions.falsify_match: Separate bills carrying the same content pass.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how many votes are needed to pass the act, says he sees strong Republicans he calls rhinos with blue backbones, and declares they believe to flip it.
mentions.quote: They're strong rhinos with blue backbones
mentions.falsify_match: Republican holdouts switch and the act advances.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is trying to find direction because so much flashes before him concerning the war, Iran, Europe, Poland and the finances of nations, and that you can scattershot something and think you know.
mentions.quote: you can scattershot something and think you know
mentions.falsify_match: He narrows rather than broadens his claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: He continues to give many loosely specified items at once.

mentions.claim_text: He names Byron and Oklahoma as hot spots he is praying over, and says the pressure around the president from Iran is only surface and it is really about his son.
mentions.quote: It's only surface concerning President Trump. It's more about his son
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against the president's son rather than the president.

mentions.claim_text: He says corporate prayer is different from his own, and describes praying for finances for projects and for the Clarity Act while seeing a membrane full of the Save America Act.
mentions.quote: as I saw a membrane full, it was save America act
mentions.falsify_match: The act advances.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the support systems as chocks placed behind wheels so the thing cannot roll and get out of control.
mentions.quote: you put stuff behind your wheels so they can't it can't roll
mentions.falsify_match: The act is stabilised by attached provisions.

mentions.claim_text: He says the void came from people with backbones who are influenced by lobbyists lobbying against the Save America Act because they are corrupt.
mentions.quote: They're influenced by lobbyists. They're lobbying against it
mentions.falsify_match: Lobbying against the act is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the pink currency again, Iraq, Babylon rising, palm trees and Rolls-Royces, correcting himself from Saudi Arabia becoming like Iraq to Iraq becoming like Saudi Arabia.
mentions.quote: I see Iraq coming like Saudi Arabia again
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi wealth approaches Gulf state levels.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it a modern day Babylon and says Iraq rises as Iran crumbles and the prince loses its grip on Iraq, with trouble within, and sees three faces in Iraq.
mentions.quote: I see a rising of Iraq as Iran crumbles
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi independence from Iranian influence and an Iraqi boom.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will set Iran back further into the stone age with an attack coming against its infrastructure and electric grid, then qualifies it to not all of it.
mentions.quote: they will set Iran back even further into the stone age
mentions.falsify_match: A strike disables much of the Iranian grid.

mentions.claim_text: He sees pipelines being opened and names Kuwait as the place once Iran is dealt with, saying you have to come up higher to see it.
mentions.quote: when Iran is dealt with is Kuwait
mentions.falsify_match: New pipeline routes open through Kuwait.

mentions.claim_text: He says Iran is in a stone age in some areas and is trying to get other nations around it to step in and help, naming Turkey.
mentions.quote: Iran a stone age some areas
mentions.falsify_match: Iran seeks and receives regional military help.

mentions.claim_text: He says Iran is trying to get Turkey and Syria to help, and calls it the art of the deal with the oil.
mentions.quote: Trying to get Turkey to help and Syria
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey or Syria back Iran materially.

mentions.claim_text: He hears Iran threatening to cut underwater internet cables, then says plainly that they do not have the equipment to do it and that it is a lot of threat.
mentions.quote: They don't have the stuff to do it. It's a lot of threat
mentions.falsify_match: Iran cuts undersea cables.
mentions.falsify_miss: It only threatens, which is what he predicts here.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are at a point of desperation about bringing forth a Mahdi, and that they have Israel in their sights and are trying to strike.
mentions.quote: it's about bringing forth a Mahdi. We must do this
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian action explicitly aimed at precipitating the Mahdi.

mentions.claim_text: He says NATO members are in la la land and that Jordan and other nations are being asked to help bring a stable Iran.
mentions.quote: NATO, these other up here, they're in La La Land
mentions.falsify_match: A regional coalition forms without NATO.
mentions.falsify_miss: NATO leads, or no coalition forms.

mentions.claim_text: He urges voting godly in every election down to small Oklahoma towns, and returns to what the Lord showed them about fires.
mentions.quote: it's so important for you to vote godly in every election
mentions.falsify_match: Local election outcomes shift in the direction he urges.

mentions.claim_text: He says a giant called the church will be awakened and people outraged, with churches burned in Europe, Canada and the American northeast and then the south, along with old historic buildings.
mentions.quote: they're going to burn churches and they're going to burn down old historic buildings
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of church arson in those regions.

mentions.claim_text: He shows a New York church burned with a molotov cocktail the previous night and calls it confirmation of what the Lord showed them, saying they do not want to be flaky.
mentions.quote: this is what the Lord showed us was coming. So this is prophetic
mentions.falsify_match: A sustained pattern of church arson follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: A single incident. American church arson runs to dozens of incidents a year, so one more is not a strong match.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said major in Europe in the days ahead, that the Islamic Brotherhood will rise up huge in France, and that he saw thousand year old cathedrals like Notre Dame burning and completely destroyed rather than damaged.
mentions.quote: cathedrals that are over a thousand years old burning in France
mentions.falsify_match: A French cathedral over a thousand years old is destroyed by fire.
